hotel.name: The Westin Lake Las Vegas Resort & Spa

verified_facts.text: The resort is on Lake Las Vegas, minutes from the Las Vegas Strip.
verified_facts.excerpt: a tranquil Lake Las Vegas hotel offering luxury accommodations and resort-style amenities minutes from the Las Vegas Strip

verified_facts.text: The resort is set along the lake's shoreline.
The property sits on the shores of Lake Las Vegas in Henderson, with a desert-lakeside atmosphere.
verified_facts.excerpt: Nestled on the shores of Lake Las Vegas, our property seamlessly blends upscale amenities with a serene desert-lakeside atmosphere.

verified_facts.text: Guest rooms and suites have lake views.
verified_facts.excerpt: Unwind in spacious guest rooms and suites with soothing décor, modern technology, and lake views.

verified_facts.text: Accommodation options include suites and Casbah Villas.
verified_facts.excerpt: Book a luxurious Lake Las Vegas suite or Casbah Villa in Henderson and enjoy breathtaking views.

verified_facts.text: The upper-level pool has views of the lake and beach, with private cabanas to rent.
verified_facts.excerpt: Visit the upper-level pool and take in views of the lake and beach from a comfortable lounge chair, or rent a private cabana for a more pampered experience.

verified_facts.text: A whirlpool sits next to the upper-level pool.
verified_facts.excerpt: After practicing your backstroke, slip into the adjacent whirlpool to soothe tired muscles.

verified_facts.text: The resort has the two-level Nuala Pool.
verified_facts.excerpt: Lounge at the two-level Nuala Pool

verified_facts.text: By the lower-level pool there is a basketball court and a mini-golf area.
verified_facts.excerpt: Nearby, join a pickup basketball game or improve your putting on our mini-golf area.

verified_facts.text: Guests can play Reflection Bay Golf Club, a Jack Nicklaus Signature Design course with lake and canyon views.
verified_facts.excerpt: Play a memorable round at our golf resort in Las Vegas, at the award-winning Reflection Bay Golf Club. This Jack Nicklaus Signature Design course offers stunning Lake Las Vegas and canyon views.

verified_facts.text: Ah Spa by Ageless Humans is on site.
verified_facts.excerpt: Yes, Ah Spa by Ageless Human is located on-site at The Westin Lake Las Vegas Resort & Spa.

verified_facts.text: Marssa Restaurant serves Certified Angus Beef and Wagyu steaks with lake and mountain views.
verified_facts.excerpt: Treat yourself to fine dining at Marssa Restaurant, our restaurant in Henderson, NV, serving Certified Angus Beef and Wagyu steaks. Dine in an elegant setting with stunning lake and mountain views
Yes, pets are welcome at The Westin Lake Las Vegas Resort & Spa.

verified_facts.text: The hotel is near Lake Mead National Recreation Area.
verified_facts.excerpt: Our hotel near Lake Mead National Recreation Area offers year-round activities

verified_facts.text: The hotel hosts the Candlelight Concert Series in the Casablanca Ballroom.
verified_facts.excerpt: Westin Lake Las Vegas has partnered with fever to present the Candlelight Concert Series in the Casablanca Ballroom.
